description: Search Confluence content using CQL (Confluence Query Language). Returns matching pages/content with id, title, version, and link.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

cql.description: CQL query string (e.g. 'type=page AND space=ENG AND title~"onboarding"').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

name: atlassian-mcp__confluence_search
